source_snapshot.items: UMC Replay Correctable CRC Read In Band
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable amdgpu RAS, query the device0/block0 UMC count, then inject subtype0/type4 at address 0x800.
source_snapshot.criteria: amdgpuras reports success, dmesg shows the expected hardware error, and the post-injection UMC count is nonzero.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; applies a correct dedicated-SUT/FAE safety gate but does not preserve the CRC-read replay tuple or attributable counter evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/IMPROVED; restores subtype0/type4/address0x800 and a correlated counter/log workflow, while keeping the decision pending for runtime bindings.

old_problem: The old record left Pending because device0 identity, release-specific tuple semantics, baseline/delta, event classification and recovery were not populated. The Master already identifies a UMC replay correctable CRC-read one-shot through subtype0/type4/address0x800. ED-16 converts the missing identities and authorization into mandatory execution gates rather than an unresolved review decision.
disposition_reason: ED-16 controls the hazardous one-shot stimulus and isolated recovery; ED-03 binds device0 to immutable GPU/OAM and the approved release semantics; ED-17 preserves counters and logs; ED-15 requires an attributable positive counter delta plus CRC-read classification. ED-19/ED-20 retain subtype0/type4 independently from rows452 and454.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row453 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3042 and next formal queue row454/history3043.
The tuple `-d 0 -b 0 -s 0 -t 4 -a 0x800` is the only source evidence distinguishing CRC-read replay from the adjacent subtype2 ODECC replay and non-replay type2 cases.

The shared UMC count cannot establish which variant ran; the command timestamp and release-specific dmesg/SEL/CPER content must classify CRC-read replay while the before/after count establishes detection.

The source's zero baseline is preserved as the preferred condition; if pre-existing errors make it nonzero, an approved baseline disposition and exact positive delta are required rather than clearing evidence.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row454 and verified its manifest identity; no driver load, injection, counter query, reset, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: AMD UMC replay correctable CRC-read one-shot injection at 0x800
test_case.purpose: Inject exactly one approved UMC replay correctable CRC-read event into the mapped AMD GPU and prove the scoped counter delta and correlated event fields identify that distinct recoverable mechanism without persistent GPU degradation.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras release/checksum and compatible amdgpu driver/GPU firmware
Device0/card/serial/UUID/BDF/OAM mapping on a dedicated idle SUT
Approved ras_enable driver lifecycle and saved pre-test module state
AMD/FAE mapping for block0/subtype0/type4/address0x800 to CRC-read replay correctable
Expected UMC delta plus CRC-read dmesg/SEL/CPER fields, OOB abort and recovery
test_case.test_command: Preserve the mapped GPU's UMC count, dmesg, SEL/CPER and health without clearing. Record current amdgpu module state and enable `ras_enable=1` only through the approved lifecycle. Reconfirm device0 identity and query `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1`. At the one-shot approval point run exactly `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 0 -t 4 -a 0x800` once. Capture output/exit/timestamp, query the same counter, correlate CRC-read replay fields in OS/BMC evidence, verify GPU health and perform only approved cleanup. Never retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact subtype0/type4 injection reports success, the same device/block UMC correctable counter increases by the approved delta, correlated evidence explicitly identifies CRC-read replay correctable handling, and the GPU remains enumerated, usable and healthy after the approved cleanup/recovery.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target and tuple approval, preserved baseline, exact one-shot evidence, attributable UMC delta, CRC-read replay classification and healthy recovery. A success string, generic hardware-error text or nonzero count cannot distinguish this row from adjacent UMC variants and cannot pass alone.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT with OOB and explicit driver-lifecycle, one-shot injection and recovery authorization
Reconfirm device0/UUID/BDF/OAM and exact subtype0/type4 tuple immediately before execution
Preserve rather than clear prior counters/logs and abort on severity escalation, GPU loss, hang, thermal or power limit
No tuple substitution, repeated injection or automatic retry
expected_evidence: RAS/module state plus same-GPU counter and OS/BMC log baseline
Exact subtype0/type4 command/output/exit/timestamp and counter delta
CRC-read replay-specific dmesg/SEL/CPER fields distinct from ODECC replay
Post-event GPU health, cleanup/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If identity, injection result or event classification is wrong, or the GPU escalates, disappears or hangs, stop immediately, retain evidence and use OOB plus AMD-approved recovery. Restore only authorized driver state and never clear evidence or inject again.
